title: Changelog
subtitle: GAAP Cloud releases and what changed

added.multicurrency_accounts: Multi-currency support: per-currency standalone accounts and same-currency transactions
added.rate_management: Exchange rate management: daily reference-rate sync with manual overrides
added.dashboard_valuation: Base-currency Dashboard valuation with missing-rate reporting
added.currency_settings: Currency management in Settings (base currency, supported currencies, rate sync)

fixed.trend_bucketing: Trend chart now buckets by the local calendar day (DEF-028)
fixed.tx_currency_pairing: To/From dropdowns keep each currency pair to a single currency (DEF-030)
fixed.settings_keyboard_nav: Settings rows and the sidebar profile shortcut are keyboard-operable (DEF-031)
fixed.profile_update_wire: Update-profile wire payload pinned and verified end-to-end (DEF-029)

added.auth_sessions: Invite-only Beta: whitelisted registration, login/refresh/logout with independent multi-device sessions over the ALE-encrypted protobuf channel
added.accounts: Asset, liability, income and expense accounts
added.transactions: Income, expense and transfer transactions, with update and delete
added.settings_profile: Settings: profile, appearance & themes, language preference
